notes.content:
[b]Dear 80's fan,[/b]

First of all, I'm happy to announce the creation of the official Retrowave Discord. Here you can talk about the game, synthwave, vaporwave, 80s, etc... 
Let's try to build the biggest 80s fan community. ːretrowaveː

ːaudiocassetteːːretrowaveː [url=https://discord.gg/gByrk87WzG]LINK TO THE DISCORD[/url] ːretrowaveːːaudiocassetteː

Don't forget to follow my social networks :

ːretroVHSː [url=https://youtube.com/channel/UCMozhcsIFFu__oelJlOCZ9w/]Youtube[/url] ːretroVHSː
ːrollerskatesː [url=https://instagram.com/rewindappstudio/]Instagram[/url] ːrollerskatesː
ːretrogamingː [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/rewindapp/]Steam Creator Page[/url] ːretrogamingː

ːretrowaveːHere are the changes that should delight night runnersːretrowaveː

A new DLC has been added: Retrowave - Custom Music

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2228880/Retrowave__Custom_Music/

This DLC allows you to add your own audio files in a folder to add them to the game!

A long and wonderful music playlist is already available in game, it is better to play with the music already present and support the artists, but if you really want to have your own music in Retrowave, it is now possible!

This helps support the development of the game and rewards those who want to see Retrowave grow and even see other games in the genre born.


[b]->[/b] 1vs1 Multiplayer mode has been added.
[b]->[/b] New car "Waterbird".
[b]->[/b] New car "Celest Evo".
[b]->[/b] 2 new wheels type have been added.
[b]->[/b] A new paint system has been added for cars.
[b]->[/b] A new Leaderboard has been added.
[b]->[/b] Even without being in the ranking, your position in the leaderboard is now displayed.
[b]->[/b] Names have been added to cars.
[b]->[/b] Change your license plate is now possible.
[b]->[/b] Spanish language is now available.
[b]->[/b] 20 musics have been added to the game.
[b]->[/b] Now the game can run in the background without stopping when you click elsewhere
[b]->[/b] A very large number of bugs have been fixed.
[b]->[/b] A very large number of fixes were made.

notes.title: ＵＰＤＡＴＥ　６
notes.content:
[b]Dear 80's fan,[/b]

Small update for all drivers!

[b]->[/b] Greatly improved mirrors on all cars.
[b]->[/b] The horn is now available on the X button of the xbox controller.
[b]->[/b] Boost is now available on the B button of the xbox controller.
[b]->[/b] ON/OFF headlights is now available on the RB button of the xbox controller..
[b]->[/b] Near miss bonuses are no longer visible when the HUD is hidden.
[b]->[/b] Car 934 is now smaller.
[b]->[/b] Height adjustment of some AI vehicles.
[b]->[/b] Some modifications and minor bug fixes.

For those who wonder, the xbox 360 controller and xbox one work with the game on windows 10. 
The check on Windows 7 will be done soon but should already be working normally.

Trading cards, icons, etc. are in progress.
